question: Within the independently published pre-soft-s projectable HMT/U(1) matter-coupling sources, is there a symmetry/equivalence/microscopic selection rule that uniquely fixes the remaining physical-metric matter-interface parameters without using RTK response or soft-s data?

independent_sources.role: pre-soft-s manifestly gauge-invariant minimal-substitution matter-coupling principle
pre-soft-s universal HMT/U(1) matter coupling and full PPN continuous-family result

decision_rule: UNIQUE requires an explicit pre-soft-s source rule that maps the published universal matter-coupling family to a single scalar-response-relevant physical ADM interface. CONTINUOUS_FAMILY_PASS applies when the independent gauge principle is compatible with matter coupling but does not uniquely determine the later universal-coupling constants, while the universal source itself explicitly retains a large phenomenologically allowed parameter region. INCOMPLETE applies if the source-lock assertions cannot be established. Absence is scoped only to the audited pre-soft-s source set; it is not a literature-wide no-go.
required_guards: all selector sources predate current RTK soft-s obstruction
do not use RTK pole/residue/remainder to choose coupling constants
do not use the observed soft-s obstruction to choose coupling constants
do not infer a unique action from gauge invariance alone
